title: Rakott Krumpli
subtitle: Hungarian layered potato, egg and sour cream bake
description: Layers of boiled potato, hard-boiled egg, paprika, butter and sour cream are baked until golden under a breadcrumb topping. Serve hot.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a rectangular (or round) baking dish with a little butter.
Peel the potatoes (boiled in their skins until soft) and cut into slices about 2 cm thick. Peel the hard-boiled eggs and slice them.
Arrange about 1/3 of the potatoes tightly over the base of the dish. Cover with about 1/3 of the egg slices. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp paprika, salt, pepper and about 1/3 of the butter.
Gently spread about 1/3 of the sour cream on top. Build 2 more layers the same way, then sprinkle the breadcrumbs over the last layer.
Bake for about 50 minutes. Serve hot. It keeps in the fridge for up to 2 days.
